entry.name: lores~
entry.description: lores~ implements an inexpensive lowpass with an adjustment that lets you add a specified resonance. The middle inlet sets a kind of cutoff frequency, but the sharpness of the filter depends on the resonance passed in through the right inlet (0 is a little bit sharp and 1 as sharp as possible).

arguments.name: cutoff
arguments.description: A number sets the initial cutoff frequency. The default value is 0. If a signal is connected to the inlet, the argument corresponding to the inlet is ignored.

arguments.name: resonance
arguments.description: A number sets the filter resonance. The default value is 0. If a signal is connected to the inlet, the argument corresponding to the inlet is ignored. A resonance of 0 is a little bit sharp and 1 is as sharp as possible.
